question: Some people think that development in technology causes environmental problems. Other people believe that technology can solve environmental problems. Discuss both sides of the argument and then give your opinion.
rater_evidence: Mike Wattie publishes these as individually corrected writing samples on IELTSAnswers. His examiner credentials are a publisher claim; these are practice estimates.

row:
When you plan your essay try to have two good strong reasons for each side of the
argument. Also when you give your opinion try to justify it.
